messages:
Ana Kim: FYI — 08:12 UTC — we're seeing onboarding uploads failing for customers on Private (VPC) in eu-west-1. Files are accepted but processing stalls; customers see truncated embeddings and occasional 502 from inference. Opening for visibility and customer comms plan.
CS Ops Bot: Incident created: IN-2026-4087 — Private onboarding sync failures in eu-west-1. Severity: high. Affected customers: 7. Link: <internal/incident/IN-2026-4087>
Mike Patel: Thanks. Adding the affected accounts list to the doc. Any idea root cause yet?
Sophia Rivera: Logs show worker processes failing at kv_cache_migration step with OOM on startup for models > 20k params when dataset size > 50MB. Rolling back a migration flag temporarily resolved one repro.
Jorge Alvarez: Customer impact: new onboardings stall at 'processing assets' and then time out at 1h. Existing production traffic not impacted. Renewal risk: medium for 3 accounts in trial stage.
Ana Kim: Drafting customer note. Short, transparent, timeline, mitigation, ETA. Can someone review the email copy? I'll paste below.
Ana Kim: (draft) "Hi <Customer>, we're investigating an issue causing uploads to stall for Private deployments in eu-west-1. We're actively rolling back a cache migration and will provide hourly updates. No production inferences should be affected. We're assigning a support lead and offering a 10% credit for the impacted billing day. ETA for full fix: 24–48 hours. — Ana, CS"
Emma Liu: I'd tweak to be explicit about retries: "we've applied a temporary rollback that should allow new uploads to complete; if you still see problems, please reply and we'll escalate."
Mike Patel: Also add link to status page and a short RCA blurb about KV cache migration bug to reassure technical contacts.
Sophia Rivera: Quick RCA note for email: "root cause: an aggressive migration path that triggered excessive GPU memory retention on model workers when processing large initial asset bundles; fix: disabled the migration flag and adjusted GC; next step: incremental migration with backpressure."
Ana Kim: Great. I'll send to the 7 affected accounts now. Who will take the follow-up for renewal risk outreach?
Jorge Alvarez: I'll own renewal outreach for the 3 at-risk trials — plan: call within 24hrs, follow-up with credits + extended trial if needed.
Mike Patel: Ops note: devops will roll out the rollback to other Private clusters by 15:30 UTC. Sophia, can you confirm post-rollback verification checklist?
Sophia Rivera: Confirming. Verification steps: 1) upload 60MB dataset to staging, 2) monitor kv_migration logs, 3) run embed/encode sanity on sample file, 4) confirm no 502s for 30m. I'll post results in this thread.
CS Ops Bot: Update: Rollback scheduled at 15:12 UTC. ETA verification complete 16:00 UTC. Postmortem owner: Sophia Rivera.
Ana Kim: Thanks all. Once verification passes, I'll send an update 'resolved' email and include RCA and compensatory credit details. Also planning a short feedback survey to capture onboarding friction points.
Emma Liu: Can we add a line offering a 30-minute enablement session? Helps reduce churn.
Ana Kim: Good call — adding: "we can schedule a 30-min onboarding session with our solutions engineer."
Mike Patel: Noted. I'll coordinate calendar invites with SE.
Sophia Rivera: Verification: upload to staging succeeded, kv_migration didn't hit OOM. No 502s observed in 45m. Rolling rollback to remaining Private clusters now.
CS Ops Bot: Incident IN-2026-4087 status: mitigation applied; in-progress verification. Last update 16:12 UTC.
Ana Kim: Sending 'mitigated' email to affected customers now. Copy of sent message attached below.
Ana Kim: (sent) "Hi <Customer>, we've applied a temporary rollback and uploads should be completing. We're monitoring and will follow up with a full RCA by tomorrow. We've applied a 10% service credit for the affected day and can schedule a 30-minute onboarding session. — Ana"
Jorge Alvarez: Reached out to two trial customers by phone; both appreciated the proactive steps. One asked for expedited enablement — scheduling now.
Emma Liu: I'll collect replies and feedback into the CS follow-up doc. Link: <internal/doc/onboarding-feedback-1922223333>
Sophia Rivera: Next steps: postmortem doc in engineering with timeline, code PR to change migration to incremental backpressure, and unit/regression tests targeting asset bundles.
Ana Kim: Closing notes: owners: Sophia (postmortem + fix), Jorge (renewals), Mike (ops rollout), Emma (feedback capture). If anything else, @here. :thumbsup:
